lemma assembly (G : Gauge) (σ σ₀ : ℝ) (A Z : ℝ) (hs : 0<σ) (hσ : 0<σ₀) (hz : 0≤ Z) :
    ∃ τ C : ℝ, 0<τ ∧ τ≤σ ∧ 0≤C ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ → Side), Tendsto (fun i => (m i).val) atTop atTop →
      ∀ (B : Bed) (p : Clip) (a b : ℝ), B.roots.strip σ₀ A → Floor B p 1 a b → p.direct ≤ Z → ∀ E : ∀ i, Link G (m i) → ℝ, (∀ i, Pointwise (E i)) →
        (∀ i, Rays 3 (E i - inputSeries p (blank B G))) → ∀ M : ℝ, 1 ≤ M → HasRecord E σ M 2 → HasRecord E σ M 3 →
      ∃ X : ℕ → Atom G 3, ∃ V : ℕ → Atom G 4, AtomWall X τ (M*C) ∧ AtomWall V τ (M*C) ∧
        ∀ f : ℕ → Atom G 2, ∀ i, Rays 5 (E i - intended p (emitBase G B f X V)) := by

proof_context.conclusion: `assembly`: given records of the input action at degrees 2 and 3 with bound `M`, there are cubic and quartic atoms `X, V` with `AtomWall … (M*C)` such that the action agrees with `intended` through `Rays 5`, i.e. through degree four, with bound independent of the input beyond `M`.

lemma orbit_gate (G : Gauge) (σ : ℝ) (hp : 0<σ) : ∃ η C : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η≤σ ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ m : ℕ → Side,
    Tendsto (fun i => (m i).val) atTop atTop → ∀ (F : ∀ i, Link G (m i)→ℝ),
      (∀ i, Pointwise (F i)) → (∀ i, Rays 3 (F i)) → ∀ A, 0 ≤ A → HasRecord F σ A 2 → HasRecord F σ A 3 →
    ∃ X : ℕ → Atom G 3, ∃ V : ℕ → Atom G 4, AtomWall X η (A*C) ∧ AtomWall V η (A*C) ∧
      ∀ i, Rays 5 (F i-turnSeries X-turnSeries V) := by

proof_context.conclusion: `orbit_gate` removes the cubic and quartic parts `turnSeries X`, `turnSeries V` of a series that is `Rays 3`, leaving `Rays 5`.

def ClassicalMatch (B : Forest S.ratio) (p q : Clip) (R T : PathData G) (ρ : fieldDir G c 1 → AxisChart G B) := ∀ j, j≤4 → ∀ i : S.Choices,
    SameJet j (fun x => tested B i p R x (ρ x)) (fun x => mainTerm q T (represent x))

proof_context.conclusion: `ClassicalMatch` says the jets of the tested action and of `mainTerm` agree for every order `j ≤ 4`.
